subject: [ZenLedger] Recap + internal align before recontact / pricing summary
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@zenledger.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's demo

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Quick summary of interest: Redwood inference for low-latency customer-facing APIs (payments risk scoring) + team interest in private deployment options for data controls.
- Key outcomes: agreed to a technical deep-dive with your engineering team, and procurement wanted an initial cost estimate and standard SOW template.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Tech deep-dive (30–45m) with Dylan to go over integration/latency profile and KV caching approach — are you available next week (Apr 5–7)?
2) I’ll send a short pricing summary and SOW template for procurement to review — if you can share an approximate timeline for procurement that helps us prioritize.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (slides)

If this looks right I’ll loop in Dylan to book the technical call. Appreciate any update on timelines/priority.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@zenledger.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — ZenLedger + Redwood

Hi Alex —

Following up on my note below — wanted to check whether the technical deep-dive is still something you want to prioritize next week. If now isn’t a good time, totally understand — can you share whether procurement/timing has shifted?

If helpful I can:
- Propose two 30m slots next week for the tech call with Dylan
- Share a one-page pricing summary and SOW for procurement to review offline

Thanks — appreciate any guidance so we don’t keep bugging you at the wrong time.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Align before re-contacting ZenLedger (no response)

Team —

Trying to re-engage ZenLedger (Alex Jensen). Sent a demo recap on 2027-03-30 and a follow-up on 2027-04-02 with no response. Before I send another recontact I want to align and make sure we present the right ask/offering. Quick summary below and a suggested play: 

What we saw on call:
- Use case: low-latency scoring for payments risk + interest in private deployment due to customer data controls.
- Primary champion: Alex (engineering lead). Procurement indicated they usually close pilots in a 4–6 week window but did not commit to timeline.

Suggested internal asks before I recontact:
- Dylan: can you draft a 1-page technical checklist (latency assumptions, integration touchpoints, recommended instance sizes, any blockers) — I’ll include this when I recontact.
- Monica: can you pull the onboarding checklist + typical time-to-production for similar fintech customers (pilot → prod) and SOW template?
- Laura: any guidance on discounting/pilot credits we can offer to keep momentum?

I’ll wait 48 hours for the docs and then reach back out to Alex with a short, consolidated email (no pushy language) and proposed slots. If we think procurement is stalled, I can ask for timing and push to nurture.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Align before re-contacting ZenLedger (no response)

Thanks Marissa — happy to take the tech checklist. I’ll pull together the following and share by EOD: 
- Expected p99 latency at 50 req/s for a 2k token model (with KV caching enabled)
- Integration touchpoints: API auth, data retention options, VPC peering notes
- Recommended dev/test/prod instance sizing for a pilot (and cost ballpark)

If you want me on the outreach I can be cc’d on the recontact or join the call — I’m free Apr 8–9 morning PT.

—Dylan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Align before re-contacting ZenLedger (no response)

Adding onboarding context — will share: 
- Standard onboarding checklist (pilot scope, data mapping, runbook)
- Typical SLA/hand-off timeline (pilot → prod averages 6–8 weeks for fintech customers)
- SOW template and standard pilot credits line item

I’ll upload the docs to the shared drive and link them here once ready. Agree that a light-touch recontact with a concrete next step is the right play.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@zenledger.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in + one-pager (pricing & pilot)

Hi Alex —

Wanted to check in briefly — no pressure — just a short update and one-pager attached that pulls together: a) a recommended pilot scope, b) rough pricing ranges, and c) who from our team would be on the technical kickoff (Dylan) and onboarding (Monica).

If you’re still interested, would two 30-minute slots next week work for a technical sync? Proposed: Apr 12 10:00am PT or Apr 13 9:30am PT. Happy to share alternatives.

If timing has slipped, could you let me know whether procurement is in flight or if I should touch base later?

Attachments: pricing-summary.pdf, zenledger-technical-checklist.docx

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
